newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Endesa privatisation schedule unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Endesa privatisation schedule unchanged.

text.p: Spanish state holding company SEPI said on Tuesday Endesa, the electrical giant it controls, would be offered to the market as scheduled with a 20-25 percent stake in the last quarter of 1997.
SEPI's president, Pedro Ferreras, reiterated the government's intention after Endesa's board of directors met for the first time with Rodolfo Martin Villa acting as chairman.
SEPI announced last Friday it had decided to replace Endesa's previous chairman Feliciano Fuster with Villa.

Regarding the possibility of entering into the capital of telecommunications operator Retevision, which is due to be privatised in the coming months, Villa said the telecommunications sector was one that Endesa was interested in.
